rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the core mechanism-level claim that a pure vortex phase emerges from TDGL phase-field relaxation driven by electric/bound-charge energy competition, with correct topology (balanced ±21 vortex array) and regime selectivity versus control. However, coverage is limited: only the trilayer vortex phase is tested (not the superlattice mixed vortex+a1/a2 phase), the model is 2D not 3D, quantitative periodicity (~5nm vs reported ~14nm) does not match, and the paper's main dynamical headline (field-driven vortex motion via zigzag-core switching) is entirely out of scope. This constitutes honest partial replication of the static equilibrium texture, not the full paper claims.
